name: FV_TRANSACTION_DOCUMENTS
description: This table stores the information for the transaction documents.

columns.name: DOCUMENT_REQUEST_ID
columns.description: Indicates the request ID of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: PAYMENT_INSTRUCTION_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier for the payment instructions.

columns.name: DOCUMENT_TYPE_ID
columns.description: Column holds an application defined number indicating what type of document this is.

columns.name: DOCUMENT_CLOB
columns.description: Oracle Business Intelligence Publisher extract of payment file as Character Large Object (CLOB) data type.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.
